change: Replace the mined, pair-specific edge ensemble with a compact pair-agnostic EMA trend plus causal pullback, RSI, ATR, and prior-volume gate.
causal_availability: All features use the current closed candle or earlier candles; Freqtrade executes the signal on the following candle.
expected_effect: Reduce selection leakage and recursive sensitivity while retaining positive risk-adjusted return across train and validation.
falsification_criteria: lookahead-analysis reports any biased entry, exit, or indicator
recursive-analysis shows a material signal feature deviation at the declared startup count
validation net profit is non-positive or profit factor is <= 1 after 0.1% fees
one- or two-candle entry delay changes positive validation expectancy to non-positive
reversed or seeded-random negative controls perform comparably or better
performance depends on the volume gate or exit rule without stable incremental value
decision_rule: Do not open frozen OOS unless code and thresholds are frozen and all pre-OOS causal and validation gates pass. A failed H001 remains documented and cannot replace the Champion.
